semiconductor_relevance: High — Techmation specializes in control equipment for gases and fluids, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Techmation is a technical trading company that provides specialized control equipment for gases and fluids used in semiconductor applications. They showcase products from renowned manufacturers, including regulators, filters, and precision sensors, tailored to meet the needs of semiconductor production.
capabilities: Low-cost, compact integrated regulators for gas cabinets
High-performance filters with 1.5 nm LRV capture performance
Precision sensors and switches for pressure and flow monitoring
